rules.conduct: Missed or superseded standing assumption requires a fresh resolved sentence supporting its exact level and a future deadline; otherwise CANCEL_REST with PULL_UNSUPPORTED. A valid postable replacement may supersede it. Existing safety vetoes still apply.
rules.pre_print: Overdue review reads only previously observed state; it can renew exact price or cancel, never reprice to the incoming print. Equal-deadline print passes through the existing fill order.
rules.bell: Later corrected ruler bell extends replay. Earlier/absent bell and unknown span preserve previous behavior. Verified grading spans unchanged; out-of-span fills uncredited.
rules.class_A: Same stored-placement diagnostic as before, not just final rests. Pulling an unsupported bid does not erase a historical bid-below-path occurrence.
rules.credit: Safety-audited corrected-span credit, with raw grade OUTCOME retained separately. Unknown spans never counted as unfilled.
rules.scope: pass 1 + 10-game determinism sample. All100 have full replay artifacts; fixed10 (ALT/GAS plus9 selected, including GANZIN) verified twice. Existing extra comparisons preserved. Remaining704 unrun. No pool, price, rubric or tuning changes. Not final organ acceptance.
rules.publication: Compact face/grade/oracle/pressure/fault/picker/history/scoreboard and operator-approved hash-bound on-demand bid-card detail and receipt/chart-marker timeline chunks only; no raw prints, full stages or full per-tick renewal streams.

audit.stage_A: Only exact-level support/cancel logic, pre-print/BELL reviews, and corrected-bell metadata in engine/builder. Pool and price implementations unchanged.
